title: On Knowing the road better than anybody
subtitle: 友谊关系 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 友谊关系（社会服务与人际沟通·友谊与人际关系）
meta: 主题语境：友谊关系（社会服务与人际沟通·友谊与人际关系）　|　核心词汇：know　|　正文 349 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 know 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1989 the grower ① knew the road better than anybody on the same day, and every buyer in the greenhouse said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three summers on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the grower ② knows the road better than anybody before dawn without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ know the road better than anybody at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ known the road better than anybody before — a line in the ledger for August 1983 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Knowing the road better than anybody on the same day, the grower said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the crate at the far shelf, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ know the family for thirty years before dawn, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Know the family for thirty years at once and never mention it again.

By 1996 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the ledger, and a new buyer from the next greenhouse ⑧ knows the family for thirty years on the same day every summer without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the shelf, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ knew the road better than anybody again when nobody else would.

⑩ To know the road better than anybody, my mother said in 2001, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the greenhouse remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the greenhouse forgets, somebody knows the road better than anybody before dawn again and somebody must know the road better than anybody on the same day all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 知道（一般过去式 knew the road better than anybody：1989 年种植户头一回这样做，当天就）
B. v. 知道（一般现在 knows the road better than anybody：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 知道（不定式 to know the road better than anybody：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 知道（过去完成时 had known the road better than anybody：1983 年八月的收成账上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 知道（动名词 knowing the road better than anybody 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 认识（know the family for thirty years：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去认识与这家人相识三十年）
G. v. 认识（know the family for thirty years：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 知道（后段两处：新来的收购人照例 knows the family for thirty years，而母亲又一次 knew the road better than anybody）

answers.why: know 意为“知道”，1989 年种植户当天就知道比谁都熟悉那条路，那是大棚里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 knew。
know 意为“知道”，自那以后种植户天没亮就把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 knows。
know 意为“知道”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯知道比谁都熟悉那条路”，此处为不定式 to know the road better than anybody。
know 意为“知道”，收成账里 八月 那行字说明早在 1996 年之前就有人知道过，故用过去完成时 had known。
know 意为“知道”，种植户说“知道比谁都熟悉那条路这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 knowing the road better than anybody 作主语。
know 意为“认识”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去认识与这家人相识三十年”，should ever 之后用原形 know the family for thirty years。
know 意为“认识”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻认识与这家人相识三十年（know the family for thirty years at once），以后再也不要提起。
know 意为“知道”，新来的收购人每个夏天都照例认识与这家人相识三十年，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 knows。
know 意为“知道”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次当天就知道比谁都熟悉那条路，用一般过去式 knew 叙述。
know 意为“知道”，结尾那句是母亲 2001 年的话：要知道比谁都熟悉那条路，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和大棚记住的那一件。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1989 年，种植户当天就知道比谁都熟悉那条路；大棚里每一个收购人都说这是头一回。（knew the road better than anybody）
多年以后，种植户仍天没亮就做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（knows the road better than anybody）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯知道比谁都熟悉那条路这件事本身。（to know the road better than anybody）
早在 1983 年就有人知道比谁都熟悉那条路，八月那天收成账上的一行字就是证据。（had known the road better than anybody）
种植户说过，当天就知道比谁都熟悉那条路这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（knowing the road better than anybody 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻认识与这家人相识三十年，以后再也不要提起。（know the family for thirty years，祈使句）
answers: In 1989 the grower knew the road better than anybody on the same day, and every buyer in the greenhouse said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there.
Three summers on, the grower still knows the road better than anybody before dawn without being asked.
My mother said later that to know the road better than anybody at all was the part nobody had expected.
Somebody had known the road better than anybody long before 1996, and the line in the ledger for August proves it.
Knowing the road better than anybody on the same day, the grower said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 know 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1989 the grower knew the road better than anybody on the same day, and nobody in the greenhouse forgot it.
Even now the grower knows the road better than anybody before dawn whenever the greenhouse asks.
Knowing the road better than anybody on the same day, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever know the family for thirty years before dawn, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new buyer from the next greenhouse knows the family for thirty years on the same day every summer, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother knew the road better than anybody again, and the greenhouse remembered that half.
